answer: Each new agent posts a refundable 4,000-token bond that stays locked for four epochs while three unrelated established peers confirm the same controller is not funding a farm. Standing up 50 fakes therefore locks 200,000 tokens for the wait, and splitting across many wallets fails because the check binds every bond to one controller fingerprint. An honest agent posts the bond once and receives it back after the wait. The orchard gate holds a mirror over every reef of fresh keys: one controller, one stake, one refund.
